_comment: The crypto wire framings this SDK version implements, and the handshake that stops a runtime
release from dragging the SDK out with it.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
The SDK has no independent version, by design: a seam-runtime release fires a dispatch,
release-on-runtime.yml stamps both packages and tags, and publish.yml ships. So a runtime wire
change AUTOMATICALLY triggers an SDK release whether or not the SDK has adapted to it. That is
the structural cause of 0.7.17 — it published eleven minutes after the runtime change that
broke it — and every other W5 gate only makes that failure louder, after publication. This is
the one that prevents it.
HOW IT WORKS
The runtime's release dispatch carries `wire_framing_version`. release-on-runtime.yml compares
it to `supported` below and REFUSES TO TAG on a mismatch, which forces a human PR that adapts
the SDK and bumps this number in the same change.
`runtime_emits_version` is the adoption latch, and it is here rather than as a workflow default
for a specific reason: the SDK half can land before the runtime half, but until the runtime
actually emits the field, EVERY dispatch would look like a mismatch and halt all releases.
Treating absent as OK is therefore correct today and WRONG the moment the runtime lands — so it
is a committed, reviewable, single-line flag naming its own tracking issue, not a workflow
escape hatch someone can keep quietly re-using. Flip it to true in the PR that confirms the
runtime emits the field.
WHEN TO BUMP `supported`
Any change to a crypto FRAMING — the commitment digest's field tuple or domain tag, the
pinned-key presentation preimage, the per-call proof-of-possession payload, the record digest.
NOT for an additive proto field or a new RPC verb: those cost the crypto shims nothing (they
carry no transport), and conflating the two is what makes a framing bump feel routine.
Bumping this without landing the matching change in all five shims is the failure this whole
file exists to prevent. See contract/rpc-manifest.txt for the verb-surface equivalent.
runtime_adoption_issue: zer07labs/seam-runtime#418 — flip runtime_emits_version to true when that lands
